name: NeurIPS 2026

name: CVPR 2026

name: ATC 2026

The conference features keynote speakers, technical sessions, tutorials, and exhibits focused on cutting-edge developments in the field.

name: SOICT 2026

The symposium aims to provide an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings and identify future computer science challenges. The event features tutorials and keynotes given by world-class speakers.

name: MAPR 2026

summarization: The International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR) provides a forum for researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to share their latest findings and foster collaborations in AI, pattern recognition, multimedia, and emerging application domains. The conference is categorized into focused tracks covering foundations of AI and machine learning, computer vision, multimedia, language processing, and AI applications in healthcare, cybersecurity, and resource-constrained systems. It is intended for researchers, practitioners, and students working in these fields.

It provides a venue to share advancements, network, and engage with cutting-edge research in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, computer vision, and cybersecurity. The conference is targeted at an international and national audience of technology scholars and practitioners.

The conference covers diverse topics such as in-memory computing, hardware/software co-design, neuromorphic and bioinspired circuits, computer vision, and emerging AI applications. It aims to support researchers, engineers, and developers working on AI computing platforms from edge devices to cloud servers.

It is designed for researchers and industry experts looking to foster collaboration, innovation, and knowledge exchange across the Asia-Pacific region and globally.

It brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners working at the intersection of AI, communications, and networking, with central themes covering the design, optimization, operation, and protection of wireless, mobile, satellite, optical, Internet of Things, software-defined, and cloud-edge networks.

name: CITA 2026

It focuses on addressing new challenges and leveraging scaling advantages in VLSI architectures, design methodologies, and application systems. The conference is intended for researchers, prospective authors, and professionals interested in integrated circuits and devices.

name: TSE 2026

summarization: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems (TSE 2026) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting cutting-edge innovations at the intersection of science, technology, and emergency management. The conference brings together researchers, engineers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry leaders from around the world to address the increasingly complex challenges of search and rescue operations and emergency response in the modern era.

The conference aims to foster dialogue among scholars, policymakers, and practitioners to deliver evidence-based tools, publications, and actionable policy briefs.

The conference encourages interdisciplinary papers integrating perspectives from business theories, financial practices, governance, innovation, and sustainable development. Key focus areas include ESG, responsible leadership, sustainable finance, corporate governance, and long-term value creation in the digital era.

It is organized as part of the 50th anniversary of the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City to address themes such as global polycrisis, rapid AI diffusion, geoeconomic fragmentation, and sustainability transitions. The event is intended for PhD students, established scholars, researchers, and journal editors seeking rigorous academic exchange and publication-oriented discussions.

summarization: The International Conference on Educational Measurement and Assessment (VietAME 2026) aims to connect scholars and experts from both domestic and international institutions in fields such as educational assessment, quality assurance, large-scale assessment, and educational statistics. The event provides a forum for professional exchange, collaboration, and discussing emerging research trends, innovative assessment models, and best practices in modern education systems. It is intended for researchers, lecturers, doctoral candidates, and educators.

Attendees can participate in keynote sessions, main sessions, regional tracks, and student pitching events.

It brings together researchers, application developers, practitioners, and enterprise leaders to discuss topics such as business intelligence, AIoT-enabled business innovation, e-commerce trading technologies, and digital marketing. The conference provides an international forum for presenting original research, innovative solutions, and practical development experiences in e-business.

The comprehensive program covers Medical and Pharmaceutical Biotechnology, Agricultural Biotechnology, Aquaculture and Animal Biotechnology, Industrial Biotechnology, Environmental Biotechnology, and Bioinformatics and Advanced Biotechnology. It aims to present the latest advances, share knowledge, and foster future collaborations.

name: ICAM-LSM 2026

The conference aims to promote education and training in microscopy while fostering strong collaborative networks across Southeast Asia and the Asia-Pacific region. Key areas include atomic force microscopy, electron microscopy, super-resolution imaging, and correlative approaches.

name: 5th ICEPORM 2026

The event focuses on environmental science, education, and management, covering topics such as pollution, toxicology, public health, remediation, and policy. It aims to bridge Asia and the world while supporting sustainable development and environmental regulation in Vietnam.

name: MPNP 2026

The conference provides an interdisciplinary platform for delegates to present research, share experiences, and foster collaborative networks. It is designed for researchers, scientists, and professionals interested in medicinal plants and advanced innovations in natural products.

The conference program features discussions on recent advances in areas such as active, biological and living soft matter, smart and functional soft materials, granular materials, complex flows, and interfacial dynamics. The event aims to foster and strengthen collaborations between Asia-Pacific scientists and colleagues from around the world.

The main themes focus on forestry, agriculture, and biomass utilization, covering topics such as circular economy models, agro-forestry raw material integration, and sustainable forest management. The event serves as a platform for researchers and practitioners across academia, industry, and policy to share best practices and build impactful collaborations.

name: NanoBioCoM 2026

It aims to provide participants with insights into emerging methodologies, single-molecule experiments, ensemble measurements, and data-driven computational techniques. The event serves as an interdisciplinary forum for leading experts, postgraduate students, and researchers to share recent results, exchange knowledge, and foster multidisciplinary collaborations.

The conference promotes international exchanges and highlights scientific advancements in the region.

name: Frontiers in Genome Engineering 2026

Bringing together academic researchers, biotechnology innovators, industry leaders, and policymakers, the conference highlights developments ranging from fundamental biological discovery to transformative applications in agriculture, medicine, biotechnology, and sustainability. The program features keynote lectures, invited talks, panel discussions, and courses covering cutting-edge topics such as synthetic biology, functional genomics, and regulatory frameworks.

Suggested topics include biodiversity and conservation, ocean-atmosphere regional climate systems, land-ocean continuum dynamics, remote sensing, solid earth dynamics, environmental pollution, vegetation in the carbon cycle, coastal engineering modelling, and hydrological uncertainties. It is intended to foster international and regional scientific exchanges.
